value.title: Rupee could rise to 91.50/$ on equity inflows, says HDFC Bank's treasury head
value.summary: The Indian rupee is experiencing a noteworthy appreciation, fueled by solid equity investment and lesser geopolitical uncertainties. Experts foresee further strengthening, potentially reaching 91.50 against the US dollar. A rate hike by the Reserve Bank of India is on the horizon, influenced by climbing inflation. Bond yields are likewise projected to increase moderately due to tighter liquidity.
